title: 1.4.0 field fixes - umbrella for the download-mode Pod incident and everything it surfaced
description:
UMBRELLA. Fabio's request, 2026-08-11: everything carded off the live 1.4.0 sessions belongs under one head rather than scattered across the board, so the release can be judged as one thing.

ORIGIN. One live incident on 2026-08-11: Fabio connected a no-GPU 'download only' Pod to install models onto the volume while a local generation ran. Every install died, the app dropped back to local, and the Model Library was left showing a mix of Pod and local truth. Pulling that thread found three INDEPENDENT roots, which is why they are three cards and not one:

- MPI-539 - the app had no concept that a Pod can be a download TARGET without being a generation ENGINE. Six failures, one root, all app-side. Fixed and committed (629ab6cb, a75c8a3e); live proof still outstanding.
- MPI-540 - the finished-gen counter had no expiry, so a batch that never cleanly drained announced itself 10-20 minutes later against an unrelated drain. Fixed and committed (ef3ebd2e); Fabio to confirm over a normal session.
- MPI-541 - the download Pod OOM-kills itself pulling HF weights, with no generation involved at all. The Pod's own transport, a different repo, and it would OOM the same box with no app bug. Open; needs the retest.

STILL UNROOTED, not yet its own card - the install-toast spam Fabio saw during the agent Pod runs ('this is installed, that is installed', all over the place). Note for whoever takes it: the download:complete handler already filters !data.modelId and the MPI-539 reconcile path broadcasts modelId:null, so that path is NOT the source - do not assume it is. First candidate is a model-level download:complete re-broadcast when the install SSE reconnects and replays. Card it under this umbrella when it reproduces.

WHAT THIS UMBRELLA IS FOR: closing it means the 1.4.0 field reports are answered - every root fixed AND proven live, not just committed. Do NOT close it on green tests alone; two of the three children were themselves patched fixes with holes, which is the whole reason this incident happened.

NOT under this umbrella: MPI-538 (lipsync Flow pickup) and the other feature cards from earlier the same day. Those are new work, not 1.4.0 field fixes.
